text:
dana: doors open in ~18 mins — quick run: we've swapped the deck to v5 (uploaded to Drive), captions were flaky on the last dry-run. If captions drop, we'll post the local transcript in #recordings and close-caption the published video later. Streaming key will be rotated to the backup CDN at go-time (ops).

jordan: thanks! where's the v5 link?

DANA: Drive link: https://drive.redwood/Allhands/deck_v5.pdf — note slide 12 renamed to 'Roadmap asks' (small wording tweak).

michelle: OBS on the studio box is showing dropped frames during the last scene test, here's the tail of the log:

```
[3409876502] obs_output: dropped frames: 12 (cpu spikes)
[3409876508] encoder: nvenc reset
```

michelle: switching spare encoder preset to reduce GPU load for the live.

devops-bot: Deploy: live-stream-key rotated by ops @ 3409876600

sam: fyi, Mic 2 (stage) had low gain in dress — leo can you check belt pack? @leo

leo: on it. swapping out belt pack now, plugging in backup shotgun as fallback. will do a quick level check in 30s.

obs-bot: Recording started: local-recorder-2 / path: /mnt/rec/allhands_3409876543.mp4

dana: note for ops — if the local recorder stops, DO NOT restart OBS mid-show; ping me and we'll coordinate a single splice later to avoid multiple master files.

jordan: leadership Q&A plan: reserve ~6 minutes for product roadmap clarifications during the last segment. Also who owns the backlog of audience Qs after the meeting?

michelle: I'll pull the transcript, timestamp key Qs, and drop clips + notes to #all-hands-followups within 2 hrs. tag me with any must-have timestamps.

sam: :thumbsup: Also: please add owners to the notes doc for each follow-up — saves us triage time.

dana: good ask. Leads — after the show, drop a one-line follow-up here with owner + ETA so we can publish action items.

michelle: temp caption fix if it flakes: ssh to captions host then run `sudo systemctl restart cap-daemon`. If it doesn't come back, fallback to human captioner via Zoom captioning (we've got an operator on standby).

leo: mic swap done. levels look good — running a 1-min mute test to confirm no bleed.

ops: Confirmed backup CDN ready. Key rotated to backup at 3409876600 and monitored. Bandwidth checks green.

devops-bot: Alert: local-recorder disk usage 86% (threshold 85%) — recommend offload after wrap.

michelle: ack — will rsync to S3 post-meeting and clip the core Q&A for socials.

dana: if we hit any streaming instability, we'll fall back to recorded-only publish + transcript. Leadership: please be ready for two quick FYIs during intros so we can stay on time.

jordan: copy. I'll ask the two clarifying Qs during the roadmap segment and flag any follow-ups.

dana: thanks everyone — see you live. post any follow-ups here. :loud_sound:
